description: Returns a per-day download time series for an npm package over a period from keyless api.npmjs.org — the raw signal for trend and growth-rate detection. Lets autonomous agents compute momentum/decline and feed agent-to-agent dependency-selection scoring. Ranking surface for trajectory. First 3 calls FREE per wallet — send header X-WALLET: 0x<addr>. No charge on upstream failure. [x402: 0.005 USDC per call on Base]
name: npm-downloads-range
